Use of 2-NMC

2-NMC is a research chemical and is listed as a standard analytical reference. It has found a wide range of applications as biochemical in research science such as forensic and neuroscience. 2-NMC has also found applications in Mass Spectrometry.

The other applications of 2-NMC derive from the fact that it acts like drugs of the cathinone class. The drug affects the brain functions in human and increases the creative potential. Also, The drug can produce feelings of motivation, social energy and confidence. The drug is also known to be used by people for recreational purposes as it can produce effects such as ego inflation and emotional enhancement.

Effects of 2-NMC

It can cause euphoria and an increase in the heart rate on administration. The drug causes excessive and forced or involuntary energetic behavior in users. Moreover, The drug can cause involuntary movement in eyeballs and vision impairment. The drug is known to cause disturbed sleeping patterns and an overall decrease in the sleeping period in human beings. The effects produce difficulty in urinating. Due to the cause of stimulation to excessive physical activity, increased perspiration is caused by the drug. It can cause dizziness and hallucinating effects while aggressiveness is also an effect on the drug.

The impurities in the drug can also cause toxicity.

Dosage and Over-Dose of 2-NMC

The dosage of the drug ranges from 3-5 mg. It is a research chemical intended to be used for such purposes but if it has to be administered then special care is required as per the advice of the medical experts.
